svg.aria-label: Mouth opening in two stages: rotation, then translation — 张口的两个阶段：先转动，后滑动

text.aria-label: Mouth opening in two stages: rotation, then translation — 张口的两个阶段：先转动，后滑动
text.tspan: Mouth opening in two stages: rotation, then translation
张口的两个阶段：先转动，后滑动

text.aria-label: Stage 1: rotation — 第一阶段：转动
Stage 2: translation — 第二阶段：滑动
Head of the mandible — 下颌头
Rotation in the lower compartment (hinge) — 转动发生在关节下腔（铰链）
text.tspan: 转动发生在关节下腔（铰链）

text.aria-label: Dashed outline: closed position — 虚线轮廓：闭口位
Translation in the upper compartment (glide) — 滑动发生在关节上腔
Retrodiscal tissue stretches — 盘后组织被拉长

svg.text: The condyle sits in the mandibular fossa with the disc on top; the posterior
band lies over the crest of the condyle.
髁突位于下颌窝内，关节盘盖在上面，后带位于髁突顶上。
The condyle turns like a hinge under the disc. This gives roughly the first 20
髁突在关节盘下方像铰链一样转动，大约提供切牙间最初的 20 mm。
Condyle and disc glide forward together down the slope of the articular
髁突和关节盘一起沿关节结节斜面向前滑动，转动仍在继续。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
